name: Belgium
notes: Scope: national (federal parliament, parties, unions, economists, NGOs), 3 regions (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels), 10 provinces, and 581 municipalities (REFNIS codes). Seed pass R001. Review 2026-10-24 (R006): 41 rows removed, 4 regraded; 64 supporters remain. The one poll (80% for a wealth tax above EUR 1m, Dedicated/Ipsos for Le Vif and CNCD-11.11.11, Oct 2023) was removed because the source page could not be read and no other source for it was found.

polls.scope: Belgium, 2,605 residents aged 18+ (1,001 Flemish, 1,002 Walloon, 602 Brussels)
polls.question: Whether there should be a wealth tax (as reported by Le Soir, RTL Info, HLN and VTM; the exact wording was not published in the coverage)
polls.commissioned_by: Le Soir, RTL Info, Het Laatste Nieuws and VTM Nieuws

polls.question: Support for a tax on large fortunes in Belgium (on wealth above EUR 1 million, main residence excluded)
polls.question_original: Voorstander van een belasting op grote vermogens in België (op vermogens van meer dan 1 miljoen euro, exclusief de hoofdverblijfplaats)
polls.support_text: Up from 74 per cent in the 2024 edition

polls.scope: Belgium, 3,007 voters across the three regions
polls.question: Whether people would have wanted a tax on large fortunes in the 2012 budget (76 per cent found its absence unacceptable)
